verdict.rationale: x402 with the hosted CDP Facilitator is a payments service, so AI-generated insights on a seller's own payment or transaction data is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only payment handshakes, settlement, compliance screening, Bazaar discovery and agent wallets. Nothing shows AI-generated insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product. Bazaar search ranking and agent payment flows are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
